description: This PHP class 'UrlLang' manages URL language settings and host modifications based on configuration and request parameters within the Goteo project.

classes.name: UrlLang
classes.description: Handles URL language and host management based on request and configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes UrlLang with a Request object, setting path and host.

methods.name: skipSessionManagement
methods.description: Determines if session management should be skipped based on URL prefix matching.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the appropriate host URL considering language and redirect configurations.

methods.name: matchPrefix
methods.description: Checks if any prefix in an array matches the start of a given string.
